name: 18271-batchdecode-qwen3next80bfp8-tp4
parallelism: TP=4, EP=4, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM, 80B total / ~3B active, 48 layers, hybrid attention, 512 routed experts (top-10) plus one shared; blockwise FP8 (e4m3, weight_block_size [128,128]), served natively on sm90.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, bounded at 1024 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, warmup 50%.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure: 1024 prompt tokens in, 1024 generated out, both FIXED, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 0. Radix cache is off, so every request prefills cold.
purpose: An 80-billion-parameter writing assistant answering thousand-token prompts with equally long replies for 512 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# NOT CACHED -- ~80 GB of weights download once.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8

tp-size: 4
ep-size: 4

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# Pinned rather than left to the default: derived from the pools the ceiling can land below 512,
# and the run then measures a smaller batch than the one declared without saying so.
max-running-requests: 512

disable-radix-cache: true

random-seed: 0
